# M4rKitS.dev

> Marcos Rodríguez (M4rKitS) is a Full Stack Developer based in Vantaa, Finland, building modern, AI-powered websites and applications for small businesses and entrepreneurs. Trained at Conquer Blocks Academy, with a background of 8+ years in IT systems and operations before transitioning to software development.

Personal portfolio site (single page, sections navigated via anchors). Available for freelance web development work. Primary tech stack: Cloudflare Pages/Workers/D1/R2, Swift/SwiftUI for iOS, JavaScript/HTML/CSS for web.

## Sections

- [Home](https://m4rkits.dev/#hero): Introduction and current availability status
- [Projects](https://m4rkits.dev/#projects): Tech stack and built projects, including M4rKcal (a native iOS calorie/protein tracking app)
- [Experience](https://m4rkits.dev/#experience): Professional trajectory and education
- [About](https://m4rkits.dev/#about): Background, certifications, and languages
- [Contact](https://m4rkits.dev/#contact): Contact form and direct email
